16/S0.subgoal: Explain the importance of tracking and how its requirements differ between AR and VR systems.

16/S1.subgoal: Categorize tracking into three types based on what is being tracked: sense organs, body parts, and the environment.

16/S2.subgoal: Describe the differences between inside-out and outside-in tracking technologies.

16/S3.subgoal: Describe the four steps of the tracking process: calibration, registration, integration, and drift correction.
